hypotheses.signature: Combine (1) Verduzco et al. (2004) analytical magnetic tilt-depth sharpness |grad theta_mag| * exp(-(theta_mag / 0.35)^2) where theta_mag = atan2(Band 9, Band 3) (inverse depth h^-1 to top of truncated magnetic basement, replacing mislabeled Band 6), (2) source-free potential-field Laplace vertical gravity curvature g_zz = -(d_col Band 18 + d_row Band 11) = -(d_x_east g_x + d_y_north g_y) zero-crossing steepness at sigma in {300 m, 600 m}, and (3) fold-visible Pollard & Segall (1987) off-axis tensile wing-crack lobes (|alpha| ~ 15-42 deg forward of visible fault terminations) + opposing-tip releasing-stepover bridges (high scalar tip density with cancelling propagation vectors) MINUS mid-segment broadside elastic stress-shadow zones (300 m < d_vis <= 2.0 km perpendicular to interior fault tangents), trained via fold-fair positive-unlabeled HistGradientBoosting and decoded at 2.8 px Poisson-disc spacing.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: USGS Qfaults and INGENIOUS surface-trace compilations terminate where range-front or transfer faults plunge beneath Holocene alluvial fans and playas. In linear elastic fracture mechanics, broadside flanks of long mapped segments sit in an elastic stress-release shadow whereas forward off-axis wing-crack lobes and opposing-tip stepover ramps concentrate tensile opening stress, driving shallow basement truncation (high |grad theta_mag| at theta_mag=0 and Laplace g_zz=0), smectite alteration (Band 17), and microseismicity (Band 16) even where surface slope (Band 19) is flat.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86C-KSLB and H86D-CTHB treated Band 6 (tc) as magnetic tilt ('mag_tc_z') and Band 11 as vertical gravity gradient prior to IR-86-BAND6-TC-MISLABEL-20261024 and IR-86-BAND11-18-GRAV-VECTOR-20261024, and used unsigned tip cones without broadside elastic stress-shadow suppression. H86E-SPBT proposed 1-D antisymmetric flank steps; H86E-MMT tested unsupervised cross-corridor phase lags (HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0290); H86E-RIDF used isotropic Hessian DEM/RTP gradients without tilt-depth, Laplace g_zz, or fold-visible crack-tip mechanics.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Steep unfaulted Mesozoic pluton or caldera-wall intrusive contacts adjacent to mapped fault terminations, or Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline benches underlain by shallow volcanic flows.

hypotheses.name: Garland-Poisson Gravity-Magnetic Hessian Eigenvector Misalignment & Discrete Gravity-Curl Seam Veto for Magnetite-Destruction Fault Cores
layers: competition Band 18 (+dg/dx_east), Band 11 (+dg/dy_south), and Band 13 iso_grav_anom
competition Band 2 rtp, Band 3 tmi_hg, and Band 9 tmi_vg
competition Band 8 geod_dilaterate and Band 17 cond_surf
hypotheses.signature: Under Garland's (1951) Poisson relation, a homogeneous unfaulted lithologic contact with uniform density-to-magnetization contrast produces co-axial horizontal gravity curvature and RTP magnetic Hessian principal axes (psi_grav || psi_mag). Compute sin^2(psi_grav - psi_mag) weighted by |g_h| * |grad RTP| inside dilatant crust (Band 8 > 0) and high shallow conductivity (Band 17), while vetoing non-conservative gridding seams via discrete curl |d_x(-Band 11) - d_y(Band 18)|.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Hydrothermal fluid circulation along blind Great Basin fault cores destroys primary host-rock magnetite (converting titanomagnetite to pyrite/smectite/chlorite) while preserving or silica-indurating bulk density contrast across the structural offset, decoupling magnetic and gravity tensor orientations along scarpless intrabasin conduits.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: GMC used scalar cross-gradients |grad Band 13 x grad Band 2| without vector-verified Bands 18/11 curvature tensors, discrete curl seam vetoing, or dilatant/conductivity coupling; H86E-HMDC targeted RTP troughs + external GDR vent points rather than Poisson tensor axis rotation.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted reversely magnetized Cenozoic basalt flows unconformably draping dense Paleozoic carbonate blocks.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 2 qualitative priority: physically isolates hydrothermally altered fault cores from unaltered plutonic contacts using competition-only bands. No score projection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-medium (~15 min CPU for multi-scale spin-2 tensor eigendecomposition and buffered LOQO validation).
hypotheses.obtainability: VERIFIED_LOCAL_MIRROR: requires only hash-pinned competition training_features.tif.
hypotheses.data_readiness: DEFERRED_BUDGET: held behind Rank 1 H86F-EWCS to stay strictly within the 3-experiment single-lane session cap.

hypotheses.name: Piedmont Alluvial-Fan Burial-Apron Censoring Propensity Gate (GeoDAWN Radiometric TC Fan-Detritus Plumes x Piedmont Concavity) for Scarpless PU Extrapolation

hypotheses.signature: Model the observational censoring propensity c(x) of aerial-photo/scarp fault catalogs directly: active piedmont debris-flow fan aprons exhibit long-wavelength profile concavity (Laplacian of Band 12 > 0 downslope of steep range fronts), low local slope (Band 19 < 3 deg), and smooth high-TC potassic/felsic fan-wash plumes (Band 6 tc high, |grad tc| low). Apply Bekker-Davis Selected-At-Random / propensity-weighted positive-unlabeled reweighting P(fault | x) = P(labelled | x) / c(x) to upweight subsurface basement/gravity/conductivity ridges specifically where canyon-mouth fan aggradation erases surface scarps.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Mapped Nevada range-front faults systematically exhibit 1-8 km artificial catalog gaps across major canyon mouths and coalescing bajadas where Holocene debris-flow sedimentation rates exceed scarp recurrence intervals, even though the master fault is continuous at 200-1000 m depth.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Prior PU lanes (H86C-KSLB, H86D-CTHB, H86E-RIDF, GEMSDOE82) assumed spatially uniform label-observation propensity c; SESSION_20261024_4D79B443 sketched TC-magnetic conditional independence rather than canyon-mouth fan-burial propensity correction.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted buried pediment bedrock ledges or paleochannel thalwegs beneath potassium-rich rhyolitic alluvial fans.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 3 qualitative priority: directly corrects positive-unlabeled catalog-censoring bias across alluvial aprons without external downloads. No score projection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~25 min CPU for two-stage propensity + subsurface PU estimation with strict fold-visible label masking).
